title: VTA Events — Invitee — Access — Show — payload
description: An invitee whose registration is going reads the event's access details — the address, the call link — from the time the host releases them. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTA Events — Invitee — Access — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/invitee/access/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/invitee/access/show/0.1#response.

sequence.description: The event's sequence, so the invitee's agent can tell when the details changed.
